art_direction: RoomScale category: architectural_opening. A source-conditioned pair of residential French doors fitted to the exact 66 by 82 inch reconstructed opening. Use the Wikimedia reference for the reddish warm-stained timber pair, tall divided glazing, meeting stile, and threshold. Keep near-full-height glazing and the visible rail proportions; do not invent a large opaque lower panel. Coordinate the wood with the supplied room photo's warm dark window trim. Show real stiles, rails, muntins, deep casing, three legible hinges per leaf, and a coordinated round knob on the left leaf with a horizontal lever on the right. Keep glass clear enough to read greenery through restrained reflections. Preserve every RoomDefinition, collision, navigation, selection, and simulation invariant.
